description: Plugins overclock installs from a subdirectory of someone else's repo. The /plugins marketplace schema only allows ./<subdir> sources inside the marketplace's own repo, so these are not listed in .synaps-plugin/marketplace.json. overclock installs them the way /plugins installs a ./<subdir> plugin from that repo's own marketplace: shallow clone, copy <subdir> into plugins/<name>, record source_url + source_subdir. Tracks HEAD.

plugins.name: tmux-tools
plugins.description: Worker-pane patterns for agents inside tmux (JR Morton, maha-media/synaps-skills).
